demand_supply_planning.what: Forecasting demand and balancing it against supply, materials and production through an S&OP cycle.

inventory_mgmt.what: Setting and controlling stock levels so product is available without tying up excess cash.

logistics_transportation.what: Moving goods between suppliers, sites and customers: carriers, freight, distribution networks and trade compliance.

warehouse_fulfillment.what: Running the floor of a warehouse, fulfilment or distribution centre: receiving, storage, picking, packing and shipping.

capacity_production_planning.what: Planning how much sites, lines and networks can make or handle, and scheduling production to meet demand.

lean_six_sigma.what: Using Lean and Six Sigma tools (kaizen, value-stream mapping, DMAIC, 5S, standard work) to remove waste and variation.

root_cause_corrective_action.what: Finding the true cause of a defect, delay or miss and putting a lasting fix in place.

quality_systems.what: Keeping products and processes within specification through a quality management system, audits and standards such as ISO 9001 or GMP.

safety_ehs.what: Keeping people safe at a site: safety programmes, incident investigation and OSHA/EHS compliance.

labor_shift_mgmt.what: Staffing and running hourly or shift-based teams: labour plans, schedules and performance per shift.

ops_performance_mgmt.what: Running an operation to its numbers: productivity, throughput, cycle time, on-time delivery and service-level targets.

equipment_maintenance.what: Keeping plant, equipment and facilities running: preventive maintenance, reliability and repairs.

sourcing_category_strategy.what: Deciding what to buy from whom: building category or commodity strategies and running the sourcing process behind them.

rfx_bid_mgmt.what: Running RFIs, RFQs and RFPs: writing the request, comparing bids and recommending an award.

supplier_relationship_mgmt.what: Managing suppliers after the deal: scorecards, business reviews, development plans and issue resolution.

supplier_contract_negotiation.what: Negotiating price and terms with suppliers and turning the deal into contracts such as MSAs and SOWs.

spend_cost_savings.what: Analysing what the company spends and with whom, then delivering and tracking savings against targets.

tco_should_cost.what: Building cost models of a part, service or supplier (total cost of ownership, should-cost) to set negotiation targets.

procure_to_pay.what: Operating the buying process end to end: requisitions, purchase orders, receipts and supplier payment, within policy.

supply_risk_continuity.what: Spotting and reducing the risk that a supplier fails or supply is disrupted: dual sourcing, resilience plans, risk assessments, supplier diversity.

supply_market_intel.what: Tracking supplier markets, commodity prices and benchmarks to inform sourcing decisions.

npi_manufacturing_ramp.what: Getting a new product from design into volume production with suppliers and contract manufacturers: BOMs, builds, lead times.

capital_projects.what: Planning, justifying and delivering capital investments such as new lines, equipment or facilities.

retail_category_assortment.what: Managing a product category for a retailer or brand: assortment, shelf space, promotions and category growth.

gov_contracts_far.what: Working inside US government contracting rules: FAR/DFARS compliance, subcontract management and contract types.
